Selected public GitHub projects related to proteomics bioinformatics, terminomics, clinical multi-omics, and reproducible analysis.

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.project-card}
### BAG3 Fractionated Proteomics Analysis
Reproducible Quarto/R workflow for missing-value imputation and differential-abundance analysis of BAG3-TurboID proteomics data, published alongside the human skeletal-muscle fractionation study.

:::{.tags}
[`Quarto`]{.tag} [`R`]{.tag} [`fractionated proteomics`]{.tag} [`reproducibility`]{.tag}
:::

[GitHub](https://github.com/MiguelCos/BAG3_turboID_proteomics-Differential-abundance-analysis) | [Publication](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-75501-y) | [Project page](projects/bag3-fractionated-proteomics/)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Standardized Clinical Data Reproducibility Demo
R and Quarto learning demonstrator showing traceable transformation of public standardized clinical-trial test data into analysis-ready structures, automated validation, and reproducible Tables, Listings, and Figures.

:::{.tags}
[`R`]{.tag} [`clinical data`]{.tag} [`reproducibility`]{.tag} [`validation`]{.tag}
:::

[GitHub](https://github.com/MiguelCos/clinical-data-reproducibility-demo) | [Live report](https://miguelcos.github.io/clinical-data-reproducibility-demo/) | [Project page](projects/clinical-data-reproducibility/)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Drug-Response Complexome Screening Viewer
Static SEC-MS complexome showcase for exploring HSP90 inhibitor-associated protein assembly perturbations in public processed proteomics data.

:::{.tags}
[`SEC-MS`]{.tag} [`complexome`]{.tag} [`proteomics`]{.tag} [`viewer`]{.tag}
:::

[Project page](projects/drug-response-complexome/)
:::

:::

[GitHub](https://github.com/MiguelCos/TermineR) | [Project page](projects/terminer/)
